Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 22  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made the critical mistake of misinterpreting the release date of *Dilan 1991*. The Planner incorrectly combined the IMDb metadata field "datePublished" (2019-02-28) with the title-year token "1991" to conclude that the release date was "1991-02-28". This is a fundamental error in interpreting the metadata, as the "1991" in the title refers to the story's timeline, not the release year. The actual release date for *Dilan 1991* was 2019-02-28, which is far later than the 2010 release of *Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World*. This error directly led to the wrong conclusion that *Dilan 1991* came out first.
